cities.label: Bengaluru
cities.note: City-level only. No provider publishes a machine-readable pincode list we may read, so exact-address serviceability is confirmed on the provider's own checkout.

rentomojo.claim: Operates in Bengaluru (publishes a Bengaluru catalogue and city sitemap)

_howToAddACity: AC-3.3: a second city is configuration and serviceability data, not code.
1. Add an entry above: id must be the provider's own city slug (both providers use /bangalore/, /hyderabad/, …).
2. Record each provider's serviceability claim with the source URL and the date you checked it.
3. Set pipeline.city in pipeline/src/main/resources/application.yml (or pass --pipeline.city=<id>) and run.
The site picks the new city up from this file: a picker appears, and its landing pages are generated at /<id>/…
